column3: The Hebrew begins the source location with the City of David and then identifies it as Zion; BSB reverses the order.
The Hebrew narrates the elders coming and the Levites lifting as coordinated actions; BSB makes the first a when clause.
The Hebrew places the priests and the Levites alongside each other without a connecting and; BSB uses Levitical priests.
The Hebrew repeats the cherubim as subject and explicitly says from above; BSB condenses this as overshadowing.
The Hebrew ends with singular it was there, whereas BSB uses plural they are there; the Holy Place is not separately named in the outside clause.
The Hebrew relates the covenant to their going out of Egypt; BSB says after they had come out.
The Hebrew first mentions the priests coming out and then explains their consecration; BSB reverses these clauses.
The Hebrew calls the relatives their brothers.
The Hebrew repeats for before His everlasting loyalty and calls the building the house twice; BSB first calls it the temple.
